name: Ocean sample theme
description: A sample theme add-on: rebrands the app as Ocean ServerManagement with a blue palette (white header and pages in light mode, deep navy in dark mode), a sample logo on a white plate and Roboto when it is installed. Overrides the app's light and dark themes while enabled. Copy and change it to make your organisation's theme (Settings → Appearance → Branding & colours can also export one).
